feeds.note: Regional trains of all Germany (RV, 11 MB static). The real-time file (2 MB, ~9,000 trips, header 17 s old) covers ALL German transport; only the share whose trip_id is in this static file is used (22% at the test, at night). DOUBLE-CHECK the licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 is share-alike (derived data must be shared alike), which may not suit the app; the static page names only 'Creative Commons 4.0'. Trips carry no routeId, the route comes from the static file.
